package main

import _ "unsafe"

//go:linkname nanotime runtime.nanotime
func nanotime() int64

//go:linkname now time.now
func now() (sec int64, nsec int32, mono int64)

//go:linkname exit syscall.Exit
func exit(code int)

var sink uint64

func main() {
	t0 := nanotime()
	for i := uint64(0); i < 1<<22; i++ {
		sink += i * i
	}
	t1 := nanotime()
	sec, nsec, _ := now()
	code := 0
	if t1-t0 > 0 {
		code |= 0x01 // the monotonic clock advanced across the loop
	}
	if nsec >= 0 && nsec < 1e9 {
		code |= 0x02 // the wall clock's nanoseconds are in range
	}
	if sec >= 1767225600 {
		code |= 0x04 // the wall clock reads 2026 or later (2026-01-01T00:00:00Z)
	}
	exit(code)
}
